metadata.policy: Baseline/development/validation may guide tuning. Final held-out runs require committed recognition code. No expected value enters recognition. Worker-process cold startup includes uncontrolled OS filesystem cache; RSS is a process-lifetime peak, not incremental per-job memory. Benchmark acceptance means a proposed value without explicit review/low-engine-confidence flags, never institution acceptance or bank confirmation.
